```{python}
# ==============================================================================
# PHASE 2: DATA LOADING AND STANDARDIZATION PIPELINE
# ==============================================================================

# 2a. Load and Process HTS (Household Travel Survey)
# --------------------------------------------------
df_hts = pd.read_csv(config_paths["hts_trips"], low_memory=False)
df_hh = pd.read_csv(config_paths["hts_hh"], low_memory=False)

# Merge Household Variables (Vehicles)
df_hts = df_hts.merge(df_hh[["hh_id", "num_vehicles_4cat"]], on="hh_id", how="left")

# Standardize Columns
df_hts = df_hts.rename(columns=config_hts["col_map"])

# Filters
# Apply the SQL-style query defined in config
df_hts = df_hts.query(config_hts["filters"])

# Standardize Period & Purpose
df_hts["period"] = (
    df_hts["period"]
    .astype(str)
    .replace({"AM": "PK", "PM": "PK", "MD": "OK", "EV": "OK"})
)
df_hts["purpose"] = df_hts["purpose"].replace({"HBSch": "HBO"})
df_hts.loc[df_hts["purpose"] == "HBC", "period"] = "PK"  # Force HBC to Peak

# Standardize Modes for Hierarchy Mapping
df_hts["mode_raw"] = df_hts["mode_raw"].replace(
    {"walk-to-transit": "transit", "drive-to-transit": "transit"}
)

# Apply Hierarchy Mapping
hier_cols = list(config_hierarchy.values())
mode_map = config_hts["mode_hierarchy_map"]

# Iteratively assign hierarchy columns
for i, col_name in enumerate(hier_cols):
    df_hts[col_name] = df_hts["mode_raw"].map(lambda x: mode_map.get(x, [""] * 6)[i])

# HYBRID APPROACH: Drop 'Transit' from HTS
# We will rely on OBS for all transit data
df_hts = df_hts[df_hts[config_hierarchy["at"]] != "Transit"]

# Group HTS (now only Auto/Non-Motorized)
grp_cols = ["period", "purpose"] + hier_cols
df_hts_agg = df_hts.groupby(grp_cols, as_index=False)["weight"].sum()
df_hts_agg.rename(columns={"weight": config_output["trips_obs"]}, inplace=True)
```

```{python}
# 2b. Load and Process OBS (On-Board Survey)
# --------------------------------------------------
df_obs = pd.read_csv(config_paths["obs"], low_memory=False)

# Standardize Columns
df_obs = df_obs.rename(columns=config_obs["col_map"])

# Filters
# Apply the SQL-style query defined in config
df_obs = df_obs.query(config_obs["filters"])

# Map Values
df_obs["transit_mode"] = df_obs["transit_mode"].map(config_obs["mode_map"])
df_obs["boarding_mode"] = df_obs["boarding_mode"].map(config_obs["mode_map"])
df_obs["purpose"] = df_obs["purpose"].replace({"HBSch": "HBO"})
df_obs.loc[df_obs["purpose"] == "HBC", "period"] = "PK"

# # Scale Factors
# scale_trips = config_targets["transit_trips"] / df_obs["weight"].sum()
# scale_boards = config_targets["transit_boardings"] / df_obs["weight_board"].sum()
# df_obs["weight"] *= scale_trips
# df_obs["weight_board"] *= scale_boards

# OBS STRUCTURAL FIX: Generate Summary vs Detail Rows
# ---------------------------------------------------
# 1. Detail Rows: Specific Transit Mode, but blank High-Level columns
df_obs_detail = df_obs.groupby(
    ["period", "purpose", "transit_mode", "access_mode"], as_index=False
)["weight"].sum()
df_obs_detail.rename(
    columns={
        "transit_mode": config_hierarchy["transit"],
        "access_mode": config_hierarchy["access"],
    },
    inplace=True,
)

# Ensure hierarchy cols are blank
for col in [
    config_hierarchy["mnm"],
    config_hierarchy["at"],
    config_hierarchy["dasr"],
    config_hierarchy["occ"],
]:
    df_obs_detail[col] = ""

# 2. Summary Rows: High-Level columns, but blank Transit Mode
df_obs_summary = df_obs.groupby(["period", "purpose"], as_index=False)["weight"].sum()
df_obs_summary[config_hierarchy["mnm"]] = "Motorized"
df_obs_summary[config_hierarchy["at"]] = "Transit"

# Ensure detail cols are blank
for col in [
    config_hierarchy["dasr"],
    config_hierarchy["occ"],
    config_hierarchy["transit"],
    config_hierarchy["access"],
]:
    df_obs_summary[col] = ""

# Combine OBS parts
df_obs_agg = pd.concat([df_obs_detail, df_obs_summary], ignore_index=True)
df_obs_agg.rename(columns={"weight": config_output["trips_obs"]}, inplace=True)
```

```{python}
# ==============================================================================

# ==============================================================================

# See report/preprocess/modechoice.py (extracted so this parsing happens
# once per tdmcalib run/import, not on every `quarto render`; see
# report/README.md's "Report data caching" section).
df_tdm_agg = vs.load_cached_per_run(repo_root, "tdm_agg")
```

```{python}
# ==============================================================================
# PHASE 4: MERGE AND CALCULATE
# ==============================================================================

# calib_run isn't a merge key -- rides along on df_tdm_agg's side, repeating
# df_observed_final (not run-specific) across each run, same pattern as elsewhere
merge_cols = ["period", "purpose"] + hier_cols
df_comp = pd.merge(df_tdm_agg, df_observed_final, on=merge_cols, how="outer").fillna(0)

# Prepare Data for Dashboard (Charts)
chart_data_frames = []

for grp_key, grp_col_name in config_hierarchy.items():
    # 0. CRITICAL FIX: Filter for valid hierarchy categories ONLY
    # This prevents double counting. For example, when calculating 'Motorized' shares,
    # we must exclude the 'Detail' rows from OBS which have ModeGroup=""
    df_subset = df_comp[df_comp[grp_col_name] != ""].copy()

    # 1. Base Aggregation (calib_run kept in every groupby below so runs
    #    don't get summed together -- df_comp carries multiple runs' worth
    #    of modeled data, see PHASE 3/4 above)
    grp_cols = [grp_col_name, "period", "purpose", "calib_run"]
    df_view = df_subset.groupby(grp_cols, as_index=False)[
        [config_output["trips_model"], config_output["trips_obs"]]
    ].sum()

    # 2. Add 'Daily' totals
    df_dy = df_view.groupby([grp_col_name, "purpose", "calib_run"], as_index=False).sum(numeric_only=True)
    df_dy["period"] = "DY"
    df_view = pd.concat([df_view, df_dy])

    # 3. Add 'All Purposes' totals
    df_all = df_view.groupby([grp_col_name, "period", "calib_run"], as_index=False).sum(numeric_only=True)
    df_all["purpose"] = "All"
    df_view = pd.concat([df_view, df_all])

    # 4. Calculate Percentages
    # Now that blank rows are removed, this sum represents the True All for this hierarchy level
    df_totals = df_view.groupby(["period", "purpose", "calib_run"], as_index=False).sum(numeric_only=True)
    df_totals = df_totals.rename(
        columns={
            config_output["trips_model"]: "AllModel",
            config_output["trips_obs"]: "AllObs",
        }
    )

    df_view = df_view.merge(df_totals, on=["period", "purpose", "calib_run"], how="left")

    df_view[config_output["share_model"]] = df_view[
        config_output["trips_model"]
    ] / df_view["AllModel"].replace(0, np.nan)
    df_view[config_output["share_obs"]] = df_view[config_output["trips_obs"]] / df_view[
        "AllObs"
    ].replace(0, np.nan)

    # Formatting
    df_view[config_output["mode_group"]] = grp_col_name
    df_view.rename(columns={grp_col_name: config_output["mode_detail"]}, inplace=True)

    # We don't need to filter != "" here anymore because we did it at step 0,
    # but keeping it doesn't hurt.
    chart_data_frames.append(df_view)

# Combine and Finalize
df_long = pd.concat(chart_data_frames, ignore_index=True)

# OJS HANDSHAKE:
df_long = df_long.rename(
    columns={
        "period": "Period",
        "purpose": "TripPurpose",
        config_output["mode_detail"]: "Mode",
    }
)


# Select columns using the config names
final_cols = [
    "Period",
    "TripPurpose",
    config_output["mode_group"],  # Preserves 'ModeGroup'
    "Mode",
    config_output["share_model"],
    config_output["share_obs"],
]
df_final = df_long.copy()

df_final.rename(
    columns={
        config_output["share_model"]: "Model",
        config_output["share_obs"]: "Target",
    },
    inplace=True,
)
df_final["Difference"] = df_final["Model"] - df_final["Target"]

# Melt for OJS
df_final_melt = pd.melt(
    df_final,
    id_vars=[
        "Period",
        "TripPurpose",
        config_output["mode_group"],
        "Mode",
        "calib_run",
    ],
    value_vars=["Model", "Target"],
    var_name="DataSource",
    value_name="Percent",
)
```

```{python}
# CRITICAL FIX: RECLASSIFY MICROTRANSIT FOR VALIDATION

# This ensures they are counted in the "Local Bus" row during the loop below.
```

```{python}
# ==============================================================================
# PHASE 6: DYNAMIC TEXT VARIABLES
# ==============================================================================

# Helper to grab a specific % Difference from our results
def get_stat(title, mode):
    try:
        val = df_boardings_long[
            (df_boardings_long["Title"] == title) & (df_boardings_long["Mode"] == mode)
        ]["% Difference"].values[0]
        return f"{val:.1%}"  # Formats as percentage with 1 decimal (e.g., "-1.3%")
    except IndexError:
        return "ERR"


# Dictionary holding all the dynamic text values
txt = {
    # All System Stats
    "trips_tot": get_stat("Trips by Hierarchical Mode", "All"),
    "board_tot": get_stat("Boardings by Hierarchical Mode", "All"),
    # BRT Stats
    "brt_trips": get_stat("Trips by Hierarchical Mode", "BRT"),
    "brt_board": get_stat("Boardings by Hierarchical Mode", "BRT"),
    # Core Bus Stats
    "cor_trips": get_stat("Trips by Hierarchical Mode", "Core Bus"),
    "cor_board": get_stat("Boardings by Hierarchical Mode", "Core Bus"),
    "cor_surv": get_stat(
        "Boardings by Mode Surveyed", "Core Bus"
    ),  # The overprediction stat
    # Express Bus Stats
    "exp_trips": get_stat("Trips by Hierarchical Mode", "Express Bus"),
    "exp_board": get_stat("Boardings by Hierarchical Mode", "Express Bus"),
    "exp_surv": get_stat(
        "Boardings by Mode Surveyed", "Express Bus"
    ),  # The underprediction stat
}
```

```{python}
        f"nameMode{key.upper()}Share"
        if key in ["at", "mnm"]
        else f"nameMode{key.capitalize()}"
    )

    if key == "mnm":
        ojs_name = "nameModeMnMShare"
    elif key == "at":
        ojs_name = "nameModeATShare"
    elif key == "dasr":
        ojs_name = "nameModeDAShare"
    elif key == "occ":
        ojs_name = "nameMode23Share"
    elif key == "transit":
        ojs_name = "nameModeTransit"
    elif key == "access":
        ojs_name = "nameModeAccess"

    ojs_define(**{ojs_name: val})

ojs_define(namePeriod="Period")
ojs_define(nameGroup="ModeGroup")
```

## Mode Share

The mode choice model was calibrated to target mode shares from the 2023 Utah Household Travel Survey and the 2024 Transit On-Board Survey. The results of this calibration effort are shown in @fig-mode-share. All mode shares were calibrated to within 5% of target data.

```{ojs}
html`<br/>`

viewof plotSelect = Inputs.select(
  [
    "Motorized / Non-Motorized",
    "Auto / Transit",
    "Drive Alone / Shared Ride",
    "Shared Ride # of Occupants",
    "Transit Mode",
    "Transit Access Mode"
  ],
  {value: "Motorized / Non-Motorized", label: "Mode Group:"}
)
// Removed: viewof purposeSelect

dataLT = transpose(dataLong)
dataTT = transpose(dataTable)

// All purposes including "All" for the facet
facetPurposes = ["All", "HBW", "HBC", "HBO", "NHB"]
facetLabels   = new Map([
  ["All", "All Purposes"],
  ["HBW", "Home-Based Work"],
  ["HBC", "Home-Based College"],
  ["HBO", "Home-Based Other"],
  ["NHB", "Non-Home Based"]
])

// Time periods now facet as chart rows instead of a Time Period select
facetPeriods = ["DY", "PK", "OK"]
periodLabels = new Map([["DY", "Daily"], ["PK", "Peak"], ["OK", "Off-Peak"]])

// Build one filtered dataset per purpose x period facet cell
filtered_data = facetPurposes.flatMap(purp =>
  facetPeriods.flatMap(per =>
    dataLT
      .filter(d =>
        plotSelect === d.ModeGroup &&
        per === d.Period &&
        purp === d.TripPurpose &&
        d.Mode !== "Core Bus" &&
        d.calib_run === globalCalibRun
      )
      .map(d => ({...d, PurposeLabel: facetLabels.get(purp), PeriodLabel: periodLabels.get(per)}))
  )
)

table_filtered_data = dataTT
  .filter(d =>
    plotSelect === d.ModeGroup &&
    d.Mode !== "Core Bus" &&
    d.calib_run === globalCalibRun
  )
  .map(d => ({...d, PeriodLabel: periodLabels.get(d.Period) ?? d.Period}))

import {Legend, Swatches} from "@d3/color-legend"
import {howto, altplot} from "@d3/example-components"

formatPercent = d3.format(".1%")

// Mode Share chart only (@fig-mode-share) -- drops the decimal above 1% since
// it's just noise at that scale, but keeps it below 1% where it's the only
// thing distinguishing a rare mode's share from zero.
fmtSharePercent = d3.format(".0%")
fmtSharePercentFine = d3.format(".1%")
function fmtShare(value) {
  return Math.abs(value) > 0.01 ? fmtSharePercent(value) : fmtSharePercentFine(value);
}

xDomain = {
  const sources = ["Model", "Target"]
  switch(plotSelect) {
    case "Motorized / Non-Motorized":
      return ['Motorized', 'Non-Motorized'].flatMap(m => sources.map(s => `${m}||${s}`))
    case "Auto / Transit":
      return ['Auto', 'Transit'].flatMap(m => sources.map(s => `${m}||${s}`))
    case "Drive Alone / Shared Ride":
      return ['Drive Alone', 'Shared Ride'].flatMap(m => sources.map(s => `${m}||${s}`))
    case "Shared Ride # of Occupants":
      return ['Shared Ride 2 Occupants', 'Shared Ride 3+ Occupants'].flatMap(m => sources.map(s => `${m}||${s}`))
    case "Transit Mode":
      return ['Local Bus', 'Express Bus', 'BRT', 'LRT', 'CRT'].flatMap(m => sources.map(s => `${m}||${s}`))
    case "Transit Access Mode":
      return ['Walk', 'Drive'].flatMap(m => sources.map(s => `${m}||${s}`))
    default: return []
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
      label: null,
      tickSize: 0,
      // Plot's facet padding is a fraction of each row's band step, not a
      // literal pixel gap -- doubled again from 0.2 to 0.4 (Plot's default
      // is 0.1) for another doubling of row gap; nudge higher/lower if
      // it reads off after previewing.
      padding: 0.4,
    },

    x: {
      domain: xDomain,
      axis: null,
      padding: 0.2,
      label: null,
    },

    y: {
      grid: true,
      label: "Share",
      tickFormat: ".0%",
      domain: [0, 1],
    },

    color: {
      domain: ["Model", "Target"],
      range:  [themeModel, themeTarget],
    },

    marks: [
      Plot.barY(filtered_data, {
        fx   : "PurposeLabel",
        fy   : "PeriodLabel",
        x    : d => `${d.Mode}||${d.DataSource}`,
        y    : "Percent",
        fill : "DataSource",
        sort : { x: null },
        tip  : {
          format: {
            x    : d => d.split("||")[0],
            y    : d => fmtShare(d),
            fill : true,
          }
        }
      }),
      Plot.text(filtered_data, {
        fx         : "PurposeLabel",
        fy         : "PeriodLabel",
        x          : d => `${d.Mode}||${d.DataSource}`,
        y          : "Percent",
        text       : d => fmtShare(d.Percent),
        textAnchor : "middle",
        lineAnchor : "bottom",
        dy         : -4,
        fontSize   : 9,
      }),
      Plot.text(
        xDomain.filter(d => d.endsWith("||Model")),
        {
          x          : d => d,
          text       : d => d.split("||")[0].replace(/ /g, "\n"),
          frameAnchor: "bottom",
          lineAnchor : "top",
          dy         : 6,
          fontSize   : 11,
          lineHeight : 1.2,
        }
      ),
      Plot.ruleY([0]),
    ],
  })

  return html`${legend}${chart}`
}
```

## Transit Trips and Boardings

Each chart below is a dumbbell chart comparing Model to Target by mode for one category, with its data table directly beneath it -- the connecting line's length is the gap, and the percent label is the model's difference from target. "All" is the system-wide total across every mode. Transfer Ratio (model boardings per model trip) isn't a count, so it keeps its own 2-decimal scale rather than sharing an axis with the trip/boarding counts.

```{ojs}
// reuses globalCalibRun (the shared header selector, _calib_run_selector.qmd)
dataBTT = transpose(boardTable)

transitCategories = ["Trips by Hierarchical Mode", "Boardings by Hierarchical Mode", "Transfer Ratio", "Boardings by Mode Surveyed"]
transitCategoryLabels = new Map([
  ["Trips by Hierarchical Mode", "Trips by Hierarchical Mode"],
  ["Boardings by Hierarchical Mode", "Boardings by Hierarchical Mode"],
  ["Transfer Ratio", "Transfer Ratio by Hierarchical Mode"],
  ["Boardings by Mode Surveyed", "Boardings by Observed Mode"]
])
// Same fixed mode order regardless of category (matches the row order the
// removed table/bar chart used). "All" (the system-wide subtotal row
// already present in boardTable) is excluded -- it dwarfs every individual
// mode, which forced the shared x-axis out so far that per-mode dumbbells
// were unreadable.
transitModeOrder = ["Local Bus", "Express Bus", "BRT", "LRT", "CRT"]

transitDataByCategory = new Map(transitCategories.map(cat => [
  cat,
  dataBTT.filter(d =>
    d.Title === cat &&
    d.calib_run === globalCalibRun &&
    d.Mode !== "Core Bus" && // <--- EXCLUDE CORE BUS
    d.Mode !== "All"
  )
]))
```

```{ojs}
//| label: fig-mc-transit-dumbbell
//| fig-cap: Trips and Boardings by Mode -- Model vs Target Comparison

// Shared with the transit-dumbbell-grid layout below, which also sizes its
// columns off these -- keep both in sync.
transitGridBreakpoint = 700
transitGridGap = 24

function transitDumbbellChart(category, data) {
  const isRatio = category === "Transfer Ratio";
  const fmtVal = isRatio ? d3.format(",.2f") : d3.format(",.0f");
  const xLabel = isRatio ? "Transfer Ratio" : (category.startsWith("Trips") ? "Daily Trips" : "Daily Boardings");
  const xMax = d3.max(data, d => Math.max(d.Model, d.Target)) || 1;
  // Chart sits in one cell of the 2x2 grid (transit-dumbbell-grid below) --
  // account for the cell being half the container width above the grid's
  // breakpoint, and full width once the grid collapses to one column, so the
  // plotted width matches what CSS actually gives this chart.
  const chartWidth = width < transitGridBreakpoint ? width : (width - transitGridGap) / 2;

  const chart = Plot.plot({
    width: chartWidth,
    height: 260,
    marginLeft: 110,
    marginRight: 60,
    marginTop: 12,
    y: {domain: transitModeOrder, label: null},
    x: {label: xLabel, domain: [0, xMax], grid: true, nice: true},
    marks: [
      Plot.link(data, {
        x1: "Model", x2: "Target", y: "Mode",
        stroke: themeLinkGrey, strokeWidth: 3
      }),
      // Target drawn first, Model second, so the Model ring always sits on
      // top where the two dots overlap.
      Plot.dot(data, {
        x: "Target", y: "Mode", fill: themeTarget, r: 10,
        title: d => `${d.Mode}\nTarget: ${fmtVal(d.Target)}`
      }),
      Plot.dot(data, {
        x: "Model", y: "Mode", fill: themeModel, r: 8,
        title: d => `${d.Mode}\nModel: ${fmtVal(d.Model)}`
      }),
      Plot.text(data.filter(d => d.Model >= d.Target), {
        x: "Model", y: "Mode",
        text: d => d3.format("+.1%")(d["% Difference"]),
        dx: 8, textAnchor: "start",
        fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600,
        fill: d => Math.abs(d["% Difference"]) > 0.1 ? themeDanger : themeNeutral
      }),
      Plot.text(data.filter(d => d.Model < d.Target), {
        x: "Model", y: "Mode",
        text: d => d3.format("+.1%")(d["% Difference"]),
        dx: -8, textAnchor: "end",
        fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600,
        fill: d => Math.abs(d["% Difference"]) > 0.1 ? themeDanger : themeNeutral
      })
    ]
  });
  return html`<div>${chart}</div>`;
}

// Per-category table (Mode, Model, Target, Difference, plus an "All" total
// row) shown directly beneath its own chart, rather than one shared
// all-categories table off to the side.
function transitCategoryTable(category, data) {
  const fmt = category === "Transfer Ratio" ? d3.format(",.2f") : d3.format(",.0f");
  const totalRow = dataBTT.find(d => d.Title === category && d.calib_run === globalCalibRun && d.Mode === "All");
  const rows = [...data, totalRow].filter(d => d);

  return html`<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size: 12.5px; margin-top: 6px;">
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th style="text-align:left; padding:4px 6px; border-bottom:2px solid #999;">Mode</th>
        <th style="text-align:right; padding:4px 6px; border-bottom:2px solid #999;">Model</th>
        <th style="text-align:right; padding:4px 6px; border-bottom:2px solid #999;">Target</th>
        <th style="text-align:right; padding:4px 6px; border-bottom:2px solid #999;">Difference</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      ${rows.map(d => {
        const isTotal = d.Mode === "All";
        const cellStyle = isTotal ? "padding: 3px 6px; border-top: 1px solid #ccc; font-weight:600;" : "padding: 3px 6px;";
        return html`<tr>
          <td style="${cellStyle}">${isTotal ? "Total" : d.Mode}</td>
          <td style="${cellStyle} text-align:right;">${fmt(d.Model)}</td>
          <td style="${cellStyle} text-align:right;">${fmt(d.Target)}</td>
          <td style="${cellStyle} text-align:right;">${d3.format("+.1%")(d["% Difference"])}</td>
        </tr>`;
      })}
    </tbody>
  </table>`;
}

{
  // 2x2 grid: one cell per category, chart on top and its table directly
  // below it -- transitGridBreakpoint/transitGridGap (defined above) also
  // size transitDumbbellChart's plotted width, so both stay in sync.
  return html`<div>
    <style>
      .transit-dumbbell-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        gap: 28px ${transitGridGap}px;
      }
      @media (max-width: ${transitGridBreakpoint}px) {
        .transit-dumbbell-grid {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        }
      }
    </style>
    <div class="transit-dumbbell-grid">
      ${transitCategories.map(cat => html`<div>
        <h4>${transitCategoryLabels.get(cat)}</h4>
        ${transitDumbbellChart(cat, transitDataByCategory.get(cat))}
        ${transitCategoryTable(cat, transitDataByCategory.get(cat))}
      </div>`)}
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
```

```{python}
df_obs_raw = pd.read_csv(config_paths["obs_board"]).query(
    "Mode_Fin == 8 and DATE_TYPE == 'Weekday'"
)

# 1. Dynamic regex and mapping from master list
stop_pattern = (
    "^(" + "|".join(map(re.escape, df_station_master["UTA_Stops"].tolist())) + ")"
)
name_map = dict(zip(df_station_master["UTA_Stops"], df_station_master["Stop_Name"]))

# 1. Vectorized Directional Logic (Board/Alight and Access Mode)
pa_mask = df_obs_raw["PA_AP"] == "PA"
df_obs_raw["B_Stop"] = np.where(
    pa_mask, df_obs_raw["STOP_ON_ADDR"], df_obs_raw["STOP_OFF_ADDR"]
).astype(str)
df_obs_raw["A_Stop"] = np.where(
    pa_mask, df_obs_raw["STOP_OFF_ADDR"], df_obs_raw["STOP_ON_ADDR"]
).astype(str)
df_obs_raw["Access_Type"] = np.where(
    pa_mask, df_obs_raw["Ac_Mode2_Model"], df_obs_raw["Eg_Mode2_Model"]
)

# 2. Standardize Names
df_obs_raw["S_B"] = (
    df_obs_raw["B_Stop"].str.extract(stop_pattern, expand=False).map(name_map)
)
df_obs_raw["S_A"] = (
    df_obs_raw["A_Stop"].str.extract(stop_pattern, expand=False).map(name_map)
)

# 3. Combine Events and Average (Sum / 2)
df_obs_boarding = pd.concat(
    [
        df_obs_raw[["S_B", "Access_Type", "boarding_weight"]].rename(
            columns={"S_B": "Stop_Name"}
        ),
        df_obs_raw[["S_A", "Access_Type", "boarding_weight"]].rename(
            columns={"S_A": "Stop_Name"}
        ),
    ]
).dropna(subset=["Stop_Name"])

df_obs_boarding = (
    df_obs_boarding.groupby(["Stop_Name", "Access_Type"], as_index=False)[
        "boarding_weight"
    ]
    .sum()
    .assign(Boardings=lambda x: x["boarding_weight"] / 2, Source="On-Board Survey")[
        ["Stop_Name", "Access_Type", "Boardings", "Source"]
    ]
)
```

```{python}
# | eval: false
# | echo: false
# | include: false

# Reference: https://maps.rideuta.com/portal/apps/sites/#/uta-open-data/datasets/6eb88701ef9741f7a19f0b5b84f66770/api

# 1. Flexible parameters dictionary
query_params = {
    "mode": "Commuter Rail",
    "route": "FrontRunner",
    "year_": 2023,
    "servicetype": "WKD",
    "month_": ["September", "October", "November"],
}

# 2. Build the WHERE clause dynamically
clauses = []
for key, value in query_params.items():
    if isinstance(value, list):
        # Handle lists with IN ('A', 'B')
        list_str = ", ".join([f"'{v}'" for v in value])
        clauses.append(f"{key} IN ({list_str})")
    elif isinstance(value, str):
        # Handle strings with single quotes
        clauses.append(f"{key} = '{value}'")
    else:
        # Handle numbers/booleans
        clauses.append(f"{key} = {value}")

where_clause = " AND ".join(clauses)

# 3. Setup API and Fetch
url = "https://maps.rideuta.com/server/rest/services/Hosted/RAIL_STOP_RIDERSHIP_TABLE_SINCE_2017/FeatureServer/0/query"
api_params = {"where": where_clause, "outFields": "*", "f": "json"}

df_apc_boarding = (
    pd.json_normalize(requests.get(url, params=api_params).json()["features"])
    .rename(columns=lambda x: x.replace("attributes.", "").lower())
    .groupby("stopname")[["avgboardings", "avgalightings"]]
    .mean()
    .assign(Boardings=lambda x: x.mean(axis=1))  # Average of board and alight
    .reset_index()
)

# 2. Merge with station names
df_apc_boarding = df_apc_boarding.merge(
    df_station_master[["Stop_Name", "UTA_Stops"]],
    left_on="stopname",
    right_on="UTA_Stops",
    how="left",
)

# 3. Clean up columns
df_apc_boarding["Access_Type"] = "All"
df_apc_boarding["Source"] = "Passenger Counts"
```

###### Table

```{ojs}
// 1. Prepare data for the table: Pivot from Long to Wide format
pivoted_table_data = {
  const current_sources = Array.from(new Set(filtered_data_boarding.map(d => d.Source))).sort();

  const rollup = new Map();
  for (const d of filtered_data_boarding) {
    if (!rollup.has(d.Stop_Name)) rollup.set(d.Stop_Name, new Map());
    const stopMap = rollup.get(d.Stop_Name);
    const currentVal = stopMap.get(d.Source) || 0;
    stopMap.set(d.Source, currentVal + d.Boardings);
  }

  const tableRows = sort_order.map(stop => {
    const row = { "Station Name": stop };
    for (const src of current_sources) {
      const stopMap = rollup.get(stop);
      row[src] = stopMap ? (stopMap.get(src) || 0) : 0;
    }
    return row;
  });

  // Create All Row (Keep as plain strings/numbers for now)
  const totalRow = { "Station Name": "All" };
  for (const src of current_sources) {
    totalRow[src] = d3.sum(tableRows, d => d[src]);
  }

  return [...tableRows, totalRow];
}

// 2. Render the Table
Inputs.table(pivoted_table_data, {
  columns: [
    "Station Name",
    ...Object.keys(pivoted_table_data[0] || {}).filter(k => k !== "Station Name")
  ],
  format: {
    // Bold the "Station Name" if it is the All row
    "Station Name": d => d === "All" ? html`<b>${d}</b>` : d,

    // Apply formatting and bolding to all dynamic source columns
    ...Object.fromEntries(
      Object.keys(pivoted_table_data[0] || {}).filter(k => k !== "Station Name").map(k => [
        k, (val, i, data) => {
          const isAll = data[i]["Station Name"] === "All";
          const formatted = val.toLocaleString("en-US", {maximumFractionDigits: 0});
          return isAll ? html`<b>${formatted}</b>` : formatted;
        }
      ])
    )
  },
  layout: "auto",
  rows: 21
})
```

```{ojs}
// ── 1. Filter by Period, Access Mode, and Calibration Run ────────────────────
_periodCode = crtPeriodSel === "Peak" ? "PK" : crtPeriodSel === "Off-Peak" ? "OK" : null
_accessCode = crtAccessSel === "All" ? null : crtAccessSel

crtFiltered = crtData.filter(d =>
  d.calib_run === globalCalibRun &&
  (_periodCode === null || d.Period     === _periodCode) &&
  (_accessCode === null || d.AccessMode === _accessCode)
)

// ── 2. Build histogram bins for each Source ──────────────────────────────────
crtBinned = {
  const rawMax = d3.max(crtFiltered, d => d.Distance);
  const maxDist = rawMax ? Math.ceil(rawMax / crtBinSize) * crtBinSize : 120;
  const thresholds = d3.range(0, maxDist + crtBinSize, crtBinSize);

  const rows = [];
  for (const source of ["Target", "Modeled"]) {
    const src = crtFiltered.filter(d => d.Source === source);
    const totalTrips = d3.sum(src, d => d.Trips);

    for (let i = 0; i < thresholds.length - 1; i++) {
      const lo = thresholds[i];
      const hi = thresholds[i + 1];
      const trips = d3.sum(
        src.filter(d => d.Distance >= lo && d.Distance < hi),
        d => d.Trips
      );
      rows.push({
        BinLo  : lo,
        BinHi  : hi,
        BinMid : (lo + hi) / 2,
        Trips  : trips,
        Share  : totalTrips > 0 ? trips / totalTrips : 0,
        Source : source,
      });
    }
  }
  return rows;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| label: fig-crt-dist-freq
//| fig-cap: "CRT Trip Distance Frequency — Model vs Target"

// ── 3. Render chart ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Plot.plot({
  height : 420,
  width  : 860,
  marginLeft  : 65,
  marginBottom: 55,

  style: {
    backgroundColor: "transparent",
    fontSize: "0.85em",
    fontFamily: "Inter, system-ui, sans-serif",
  },

  caption: [
    crtPeriodSel,
    crtAccessSel === "All" ? "All Access Modes" : `${crtAccessSel} Access`,
    `${crtBinSize}-mile bins`
  ].join("  ·  "),

  x: {
    label: "CRT Trip Distance (miles) →",
    tickSpacing: 60,
  },

  y: {
    label: crtViewSel === "Trip Count" ? "↑ Number of Trips" : "↑ Share of Trips",
    grid: true,
    tickFormat: crtViewSel === "Trip Count"
      ? d => d.toLocaleString("en-US", {maximumFractionDigits: 0})
      : d3.format(".1%"),
  },

  color: {
    legend : true,
    domain : ["Target", "Modeled"],
    range  : [themeTarget, themeModel],
  },

  marks: [
    // Modeled (blue) — drawn first so Target sits on top where they overlap
    Plot.areaY(crtBinned.filter(d => d.Source === "Modeled"), {
      x          : "BinLo",
      y          : crtViewSel === "Trip Count" ? "Trips" : "Share",
      fill       : themeModel,
      stroke     : themeModel,
      fillOpacity: 0.35,
      strokeWidth: 1.5,
      curve      : "step-after",
    }),

    // Target (green)
    Plot.areaY(crtBinned.filter(d => d.Source === "Target"), {
      x          : "BinLo",
      y          : crtViewSel === "Trip Count" ? "Trips" : "Share",
      fill       : themeTarget,
      stroke     : themeTarget,
      fillOpacity: 0.35,
      strokeWidth: 1.5,
      curve      : "step-after",
    }),

    Plot.tip(crtBinned, Plot.pointerX({
      x    : "BinMid",
      y    : crtViewSel === "Trip Count" ? "Trips" : "Share",
      title: d => {
        const val = crtViewSel === "Trip Count"
          ? d.Trips.toLocaleString("en-US", {maximumFractionDigits: 0})
          : d3.format(".1%")(d.Share);
        return `${d.Source}\n${d.BinLo}–${d.BinHi} mi\n${val}`;
      },
    })),

    Plot.ruleY([0]),
  ],
})
```
